notes: Pass 1: no nCino own page returned text to the fetch tool (www.ncino.com answered HTTP 429 with a Vercel Security Checkpoint on the home and /our-platform pages; investor.ncino.com timed out on the two cited investor pages), so all 17 claims were unverifiable. Pass 2 (8 Oct): all seven pages in needs_browser_read were read once in a real browser (manifest method browser) and the list is now empty. The browser reads settle eight claims as true: C01 (built on Salesforce), C04 (cloud services) and C16 (Salesforce Platform subscription included) from the Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended 31 Jan 2026 on investor.ncino.com; C02 and C03 (CRM and Financial Services Cloud connectivity) from the 21 Dec 2023 Salesforce partnership release; C07 (nCino Mortgage Suite) from the platform page; C08 (SimpleNexus as acquired mortgage technology) from the 10-K; C09 (nCino Commercial Lending) from the commercial lending page. Still unverifiable: C05 and C06 (the pages name the product the nCino Platform and document no rename), C10 and C11 (the /essentials URL now redirects to /credit-unions, which names no Essentials package; no dated retirement), C12 and C13 (a Community & Regional Banks segment, asset-based pricing introduced in fiscal 2025, but no community package or modular pricing), C14 and C15 (no page states price publication or contract length) and C17 (no Docman module named). The 10-K snapshot is truncated at 50,000 characters (Item 1 and the start of Item 1A only). Reviewer: C08 is classed true on the 10-K acquisition line plus the platform page naming nCino Mortgage Suite; the pages do not say SimpleNexus was renamed. C16 is classed true on the 10-K reseller clause; it applies to 'certain solutions'. Pass 2 completeness: the gap lines and the comparison tables carry no further in-scope statement about nCino (best-fit rows, implementation times, review ratings, capability and positioning lines such as 'Salesforce-integrated environment' or 'Salesforce ecosystem overhead' were not coded), and no answer states nCino's founding, headquarters, ownership, customer count or acquisitions. The cited Commercial Lending Essentials product sheet on assets.ctfassets.net is a PDF and was not read (the fetch tool does not extract PDF text); www.ncino.com and investor.ncino.com stay closed to the fetch tool after two blocked answers each. Not coded: name mentions of SimpleNexus as a stand-alone alternative (q4 Perplexity 2 and 3, q8 Google AI Overviews 3), implementation times, review ratings, capability lists, and lines labelled as proxy or estimated cost. No claim is wrong or stale, so the consistency check changed nothing and no cited page was read for causes.
